description: Korean business passenger car expense limits (법인세법 제27조의2, 소득세법 제33조의2): without a logbook only 15M KRW of annual car costs count as business use; business-use depreciation (5-year straight line; lease = lease fee net of insurance/tax/repairs; long-term rent = 70% of rent) above 8M a year is carried over. Returns total, business ratio, deductible, disallowed, carry-over, tax saved and the amount deductible with a full logbook. Requires business-only car insurance; special corporations (500M/400M rules) not covered.

amount.description: own: purchase price incl. VAT; lease: annual lease fee net of included insurance/tax/repairs; rent: annual rent (KRW)

businessShare.description: Business share of distance from the logbook (0-1)

marginalRate.description: Marginal tax rate including local tax (0-1, default 0.264)

otherCosts.description: Annual fuel, insurance, car tax, repairs, tolls (KRW)

ownership.description: own = purchased; lease; rent = long-term rental

name: calculate_kr_business_car_expense
title: calculate kr business car expense
